verdict.rationale: Claude Code's automations (skills, hooks, CLAUDE.md) are stored as plain files and it has native git integration (staging, commits, branches, PRs) plus diff review UIs, which implicitly enables versioning and review of these artifacts. However, there's no explicit feature for versioning, reviewing, or rolling back 'automations' as a first-class concept (e.g., automation history/rollback), so this relies on inferring git usage rather than a dedicated capability.
